limits: New conditional reconstruction on declared measured panels: BOKE Betula/Fraxinus/Ulmus and BUS Betula/Ulmus. BUS Fraxinus remains unmeasured, not zero or predicted. Relative three-taxon cover is not whole vegetation.

The BOKE multinomial factors into its conditional Betula/Ulmus likelihood and a Fraxinus-versus-panel-remainder binomial. The free Fraxinus coordinate saturates the latter at every Betula/Ulmus cover ratio. The profiled ratio and likelihood deviance therefore retain the original two-taxon result; the extra grains do not add cross-site confirmation of that ratio or Fraxinus.

Both cores' exposed counts enter the original fit. These are descriptive in-sample likelihoods, not withheld prediction, ecological accuracy, a preferred field model, historical reproduction or chi-square p-values. Original sample exclusions, age windows, native count units, source rights and geometry limitations remain.

Full-panel raw negative log likelihood omits multinomial combinatorial constants. Its mean uses the larger measured-grain denominator and must not be compared with the projected mean as an improvement. The fitted Fraxinus binomial contribution cancels in the corresponding saturated-model deviance.

The model conditions on each declared measured panel. Recorded counts within a panel must follow that multinomial observation model; selective reporting or heterogeneous pooled samples are not validated by this calculation. BOKE alone identifies Fraxinus relative to the other two taxa.

No three-taxon uncertainty interval is calculated. The earlier projected counting sets are not joint intervals for this composition. PPE, saved non-rigorous quadrature, geometry, chronology and common-field-cover assumptions remain fixed or unqualified; no fits, kernels or count-tail evaluations are added.
original_point_limits: New conditional reconstruction of relative Betula/Ulmus cover, not historical reproduction or whole vegetation. Original exact-panel matched groups remain zero; projection creates these new groups. Original full-panel sample eligibility/exclusions remain: projection never newly admits BOKE samples missing Fraxinus.
Both sites' counts enter each fit. Likelihood and deviance are descriptive in-sample statistics, not independent prediction, vegetation accuracy, transfer validation or chi-square p-values.

Two distinct physical places do not establish independent sampling or common cover. Thirteen windows repeatedly use the same two cores; pooled native samples are not proven homogeneous multinomial trials.

Named calibrated BP point ages retain AD1950 as reference. Missing raw age bounds do not imply certainty. BUS chronology borrows dates from Agerods mosse and Krageholmssjon; no recalibration or chronology uncertainty is fitted.

PPE and saved receiver-annulus K remain fixed. Static metadata disk radii, 3m/s wind, 100km extent and empirical metre-based diffusion coefficient are declared scenarios; no new kernel, geometry/PPE uncertainty or field applicability is established.
Fraxinus_original_panel_count null means Fraxinus is outside the original saved parameter panel, not a measured zero. All reported native pollen mass and original panel mass are retained separately.

Literal taxon/parameter names do not supply human-approved taxonomic equivalence. Historical metadata NR flags and local raw-source custody remain; no redistribution, permission, human review or release approval follows.

Geometry-correct-then-pool means close(sum_site count/(PPE*K)), retaining grain effort. It is not the historical equal-place mean of independently closed inverse covers and does not reproduce prior held-out forward scores.
Numerical stationarity/count-balance and relative-information checks are arithmetic policies, not uncertainty or certified cover-error bounds. Nonconverged candidates are withheld.
